units.source_text: 客人似乎坚持说，彩车的队伍从四条大街走过宽阔的现代化的河原街，

en.t: The visitor seemed to insist that the procession of festival floats went from Shijo Avenue along the broad, modern Kawaramachi Street,

units.source_text: 然后拐到新开的御池街，是为了所谓“观光”才在市政府前设置观礼席的。

en.t: then turned onto the newly opened Oike Street, and that viewing seats had been set up in front of City Hall for the sake of so-called tourism.
